note: Earlier conversations in Ask Dormouse's log, already redacted. age_days is how long ago each one happened, so the demo's retention step gives the same result whenever it runs. Everything here is made up.

records.message: My heating comes on before the time I set. Why?
records.reply: That's Warm Wake: it starts the heating early so your home reaches the target temperature at the start of each period.

records.message: How do I invite [NAME] to my home?
records.reply: Open Settings > Household > Invite and enter their email address. The invitation works for seven days.

records.message: The display shows E-401. What does that mean?
records.reply: E-401 means the backup batteries are low. Replace them with two new AA batteries.

records.message: Can I turn off geofencing for just my phone?
records.reply: Yes. Each member can stop sharing their location in Settings > Household > Location sharing.

records.message: Does Dormouse keep my heating history forever?
records.reply: No. Your heating history is kept for two years, and then deleted.

records.message: The hall thermostat clicks loudly when the heating comes on.
records.reply: The click is the normal sound of the thermostat switching the boiler on and off.

records.message: How long does a boost last?
records.reply: A boost lasts one hour, unless you cancel it.
